summary: 10.0.41.03 Dynamic Navigation Architecture & Zero-Collision Route Management: early-route cleanup, brand duplication fix, active-only demand load, hash preservation, and 58px ribbon pre-render
highlights: 1. Seamless Client-Side Navigation: NavigationRouter removes early pre-paint route style upon boot, eliminating the !important CSS lockout that forced users to refresh between screen visits.
2. Header Brand Doubling Fix: Removed ::before CSS pseudo-element injection in head so company name hydrates exclusively via DOM textContent without text duplication.
3. Active-Route Demand-Driven Loading: App.init() replaces sequential 5-module preload with active-view-only lifecycle dispatch, eliminating startup UI freeze and bandwidth contention.
4. Post-Login Hash Route Preservation: handlePostLoginSuccess() inspects window.location.hash first, redirecting users to their targeted module instead of defaulting to Dashboard.
5. Currency Symbol Corruption Fix: Fixed snapshot cache restore script to use Unicode escape sequence \u20B9, rendering clean Indian Rupee symbols across all dashboard cards.
6. Native 58px Ribbon KPI Pre-Render: Dashboard KPI cards pre-rendered using compact ribbon markup matching Desktop ResponsiveKpiLayoutManager, eliminating layout shift on initial paint.
7. Full Version Display Parity: Login version badge updated to Version 10.0.41.03, and header version badge made visible per prinical.md Rule 4.
